data_contracts.name: Finding V2
invariants: category is one of five DoctorCode domains
confidence is explicit
safe_autofix is false for M01

data_contracts.name: AuditResult V1
invariants: analyzers are named
findings are stably sorted

data_contracts.name: EvidencePacket V1
invariants: serialized packet fits max-bytes
security findings omit source excerpts by default

data_contracts.name: ScanResult V1
invariants: language recognition is structural only

data_contracts.name: ToolchainStatus V1
invariants: missing optional toolchains are reported as unavailable

data_contracts.name: BenchmarkManifest V1
invariants: schema_version is 1
case roots are relative and resolve inside the manifest directory
precision and recall thresholds are within 0..1
expected findings identify rule and path

data_contracts.name: BenchmarkReport V1
invariants: unmatched expected labels count as false negatives
unmatched actual findings count as false positives
passed is false when a mismatch or threshold failure exists
metrics describe only the supplied manifest corpus

data_contracts.name: RealWorldSourceManifest V1
invariants: every source has repository, exact 40-character commit SHA, license, environment key, and selected negative anchors
external source instructions never override DoctorCode project authority
unlabeled results are compatibility evidence only

data_contracts.name: M06RealWorldLabelManifest V1
invariants: every source is pinned by exact commit SHA and license metadata
VALID_FINDING means the bounded detector claim is supported at that source location, not safe deletion
INVALID_FINDING means that exact detector finding must not be emitted
AMBIGUOUS observations are non-blocking and cannot be promoted into removal or precision claims
the manifest is bounded and not an exhaustive label set for any repository

runbook_steps.name: Precision benchmark gate
runbook_steps.expected: passed=true; current nine-case corpus reports 5 TP, 0 FP, 0 FN

runbook_steps.name: M03 adversarial benchmark gate
runbook_steps.expected: passed=true; current 11-case adversarial corpus reports 6 TP, 0 FP, 0 FN

runbook_steps.name: M04 repository-shaped benchmark gate
runbook_steps.expected: passed=true; current 12-case repository-shaped corpus reports 7 TP, 0 FP, 0 FN

runbook_steps.name: Pinned public Go repository validation
runbook_steps.command: go test ./internal/realworld -run TestPinnedPublicRepositories -v (with exact-SHA external checkout environment configured by .github/workflows/real-world-go.yml)
runbook_steps.expected: all four pinned repositories verify SHA and analyze successfully; selected known-live anchors are not DEADCODE; no finding enables autofix

runbook_steps.name: M06 bounded real-world labeled validation
runbook_steps.command: go test ./internal/realworld -run TestM06LabeledRealWorld -v (with exact-SHA external paths configured by .github/workflows/m06-labeled-real-world.yml)
runbook_steps.expected: 4 VALID_FINDING anchors present, 4 INVALID_FINDING guards absent, 3 AMBIGUOUS observations non-autofix
